fragen.frage: After downloading, the checksum reports “FAILED”. What do you do?
antworten: Carry on anyway – it'll be fine
Stop, delete the file and download it again; if the error stays, get help
fragen.erklaerung: A wrong checksum means: the file isn't the one the vendor published.

fragen.frage: What does “--root …/Agent-Files/pdf” do for the MCP server?
antworten: PdfCraft may only read and save in this folder
PdfCraft saves everything on the internet
fragen.erklaerung: The agent only gets the folder it needs for the task – not your whole Agent PC.
